fault.boundary: client TCP connection reset after sending the complete command and before consuming the response
fault.server_outcome: transaction may commit while response delivery is unknown or fails
fault.recovery: restart process and replay the identical entity/command/fingerprint request

limitations: TCP reset timing is a source-level fault slice, not a complete proxy/network chaos model
outbox external delivery is not executed
official Nakama client/socket behavior is not compared
TLS, pool, cancellation and automatic serialization retry are not integrated
